images.label: briefing-tone
images.source: Actual public viewport; no DOM/style/pose injection.

observations.observation: Anderson and Tali portraits, active speaker names, wrapped text and dialogue choices are readable. The councillor portraits remain generic diamonds, explicitly labelled Conseiller turien / Conseillère asari.
The three captured responses retain the demand for evidence; Udina, Anderson and both councillors are also recorded from real visible speaker controls in the run report.

The pre-event intro has no recording detail. The received-proof capture shows the recording details after public acceptance; the actual export records her recruitment. An import toast temporarily overlaps the end of the intro sentence in the before-proof capture. The later evidence capture is unobscured.

Anderson command text, investigation leads, final confirmation and the reloaded three enabled destinations are visible. Existing earlier physical Normandy access remains, so DIA-anderson-transmission is still partial.
